message.content: I’m not sure I understand your request. Apple Inc. (AAPL), Alphabet Inc. (GOOGL/GOOG), and Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) all trade on the Nasdaq stock market, not the New York Stock Exchange. Did you mean “latest closing prices and volumes” for these companies on their respective exchanges (i.e., Nasdaq)? If so, I can fetch that data for you.
